info.title: Epoch Platform conversation sharing
info.description: Share a conversation by link: the same routes, JSON, table and files as EpochBackend, so the front door can send them to either service. A link resolves to a revocable grant; only a reader who passes its access check gets short-lived CDN signatures for the frozen copy and the captured runs. A link someone may not open answers 404, never 403. Run facts come from the job index, never from the caller.

user.description: A Cognito token from the Terminal, or an Epoch delegated token with the research scope

projection.description: The conversation copy, already redacted by EpochAI. Must be a JSON object; stored as received

execution_ids.description: Completed runs of this conversation to include; their files are read from the job index, never from the caller

audience.description: Exactly 'anyone_with_link' opens without sign-in; any other value means named_subjects

subjects.description: Invited email addresses for named_subjects, at most 50; stored lower-cased

execution_ids.description: Completed runs of this conversation to include; their files are read from the job index, never from the caller

expected_snapshot_version.description: The version the owner last saw; the update is refused with 409 if the link has moved on

audience.description: Who may open the link. Left out: unchanged

subjects.description: The full list of invited email addresses, at most 50; replaces the stored list and is stored lower-cased. Left out: unchanged

expires_in_seconds.description: From now: 1..31536000, or 0 to clear the expiry. Left out: unchanged

expected_access_version.description: The access_version the owner last saw; refused with 409 if access changed since

access_version.description: Bumped by each change of audience, invitations or expiry; 0 until the first. Send it back as expected_access_version

dashboard.description: The publication's dashboard with the owner's saved edits, frozen at share time

captured_at.description: When the run was created (epoch milliseconds), from its own metadata

source.description: Always empty: readers get the setup, never the script (as EpochBackend returns it)

ExecutionStudySnapshot.description: The study exactly as this run ran it, from the sealed settings beside the run; never the live definition

deleted.description: The run was deleted or is no longer the captured completed generation

snapshot_url.description: The frozen conversation copy on the CDN; append snapshot_signed_query

expires_epoch.description: When the signatures in this response stop working (epoch seconds)

additionalContext.description: Publish refusals: status, execution_id and detail

post.description: Publish a frozen copy of the conversation and its completed runs (with their dashboards as the owner last saved them) and create a link. Refusals name the run and the cause in additionalContext: execution_not_found (404), execution_not_ready (409), execution_mismatch (400), invalid_request (400), storage_error (500).

get.description: The caller's active links for one conversation.

delete.description: Stop every link of one of the caller's conversations and delete their frozen copies. Idempotent. EpochAI calls it when a conversation is deleted.

200.description: Every link of the conversation is stopped

put.description: Publish an update of the conversation under the same link and access. A new immutable version; 409 if the link moved past expected_snapshot_version.

200.description: The link at its new version

get.description: Conversations shared with the caller’s verified email. Public, stopped and expired links are omitted. Unverified or missing email returns an empty list. Only the owner’s display name is returned: no owner email, other invitees or view counters. Recipient rows are lookup hints; each current grant and frozen snapshot is checked before returning it.

Owner-only published versions, newest first, including counts and the current selection. Legacy copies whose publication cannot be identified are explicitly unavailable; unpublished losing candidates are never offered. All versions are retained.

put.description: Owner-only selection of a retained published version. The URL, access and counters stay unchanged. Compare-and-set against expected_current_version; a concurrent change returns 409. The next explicit Publish update advances to a new version and makes it current.

200.description: The link at its selected version

get.description: Open a link. Signed out works for anyone_with_link; an invited link answers 401 signed out and opens for the owner and for invited people signed in with that verified email. A link the caller may not open, a revoked one and an unknown one answer 404. Run credentials authorize only tearsheets/ result files, never config.json or other files at the run root. Signatures last ten minutes; open again for new ones. Signed-out opens are rate limited per address.

200.description: The frozen conversation and its runs, with short-lived CDN signatures

delete.description: Stop one link and delete its frozen copies. Idempotent; another owner's link answers 404. A signature already handed out lasts until it expires.

patch.description: Change who can open a link without changing its URL: audience, the full list of invited emails, and the expiry. The link id, its published versions and its view counters stay as they are. Compare-and-set on access_version: 409 if access changed since the owner last saw it. Narrowing access takes effect on the next open; CDN signatures already handed out keep working until they expire, ten minutes by default. Invitations follow the create rules (email addresses, lower-cased, at most 50, repeats dropped); named_subjects needs at least one. Another owner's link, a stopped one and an expired one answer 404.

200.description: The link with its new access and access_version
